messages:
Nina B: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing workload presets + shadow sampling + a budget-guard for remote fallbacks. wanted a quick sanity check.

Tom H: can you sketch the presets?

Nina B: interactive -> balanced, embeddings -> quality-first, batch -> cost-first. default fallback path with hysteresis and per-endpoint override.

Isha P: shadow sampling sounds good. what rate? storage?

Nina B: 1% by default, persist only summaries (cosine delta, degscore); full samples only for top 0.5% anomalies. keeps storage small.

Marco L: billing: remote pool fallbacks can spike cost. need a per-tenant budget-guard that blocks auto-fallback beyond soft delta (5%) and triggers alert for manual review.

Tom H: hysteresis? we need to avoid noisy flips.

Nina B: require 3 consecutive 5m windows > threshold OR single window with 5x severity. add 30m cooldown after manual intervention.

Isha P: compatibility check must be explicit (KV format + kernel ABI). runtime should expose can_switch(model,variant) API so UI and ops can preview impact.

ops-bot: created alert "ML-EMB-SMPL-1789" -> condition: prod && customer_facing && embeddings_degscore > 0.04 for 3x 5m windows. Notifies: #eng-ml-oncall.

Marco L: agree on preview API and budget guard. action items: 1) compatibility matrix schema 2) shadow sampler impl (ephemeral diffs) 3) budget-guard config + alerting 4) runtime can_switch API + UI tile. I'll coordinate billing review.

Nina B: thanks all — I'll open a PR with config and tests this week.
